xlg06_rookie_prior_vs_realised_value.description: XLG-06 rookie prior (walk-forward ridge on log overall draft pick, class-standardised pre-draft grade and final-college-season usage share, fit only on strictly earlier draft classes) versus realised first-NFL-season value on the injury-value scale, both standardised within arm; draft-class-blocked bootstrap, 20,000 resamples, seed 20260911
xlg06_rookie_prior_vs_realised_value.notes: n=1288 rookies with at least 100 rookie-season snaps at a position the NFL value scale can measure (RB/WR/TE offensive skill, DL/LB/DB defence). Spearman +0.1675. QB and OL are excluded because the scale has no metric for them.
xlg06_rookie_prior_vs_realised_value.plain_summary: A rookie's college production share and where he was drafted really do line up with how well he plays as a rookie, but only loosely - it is a real signal, not a strong one.
